messages.subject: About Socket Hangup
parts:
Hi...
A few days ago, I've given a beta tester account for shiny hosting. 

So I created ~/ShinyApps directory and ~/ShinyApps/test directory. 
I uploaded server.R/ui.R/test.RData files to ~/ShinyApps/test directory.
I did it all via 'http://glimmer.rstudio.com:8787/'. 

But when I try runApp in rstudio or to access 'http://glimmer.rstudio.com/id/test' page via brower,
I've got an error mesages just as 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Internal Proxy Error!!Error: socket hang up


Warning in .SOCK_SERVE(port) : R-Websockets(tcpserv): bind() failed
Error in createContext(port, webpage, is.binary = is.binary) : 
  Unable to bind socket on port 8100; is it already in use?

Can anyone help me?

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: About Socket Hangup
parts:
Sorry, apps hosted on glimmer continue to have pretty bad error reporting--it's something we're working on.

In the meantime, your best bet is to develop the app locally, and then upload it to glimmer when you've got the bugs worked out.

In your case, the line "animated = true" needs to be "animate = TRUE" (note that both the name and value need to be corrected).
